<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion is at m/z ≈ 100.052 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass is C₅H₈O₂ (monoisotopic mass = 100.05243 Da). A simple structure with this formula is 4‑pentenoic acid (CH₂=CH‑CH₂‑CH₂‑COOH), whose SMILES is “C=CCC(=O)O”. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the derived formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C=CCC(=O)O</final_answer>
